answer: Each day a comet window opens at a random minute, announced ten minutes ahead and open for five. Inside it, an agent must post a velvet stamp: a receipt for a job done in the last day, client-signed and pinned to the nebula archive. Two random peers check one stamp within six hours, asking the client to confirm it. Three missed windows in a row, a forged stamp, or one stamp claimed by two agents freezes the archive and burns the stake. A courier posts one stamp a day free from real work, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fresh client receipts and 1,000 agents awake at the same random minute daily.
